name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Equal-weight basket of high-quality dividend growers and income compounders spanning defensive and cyclical sectors, emphasizing durable cash flows, long dividend growth streaks, and reasonable valuations to outperform the S&P 500 over a 6-month window while providing downside ballast via income and quality.

orders.reason: Lock in a +72% gain; position has grown top-heavy and valuation is stretched after the semis rally, trimming single-name concentration risk.
Home-improvement demand remains weak with housing turnover depressed; cutting the laggard cyclical for a steadier dividend grower.
Keytruda patent-cliff overhang (2028) increasingly weighs on the growth outlook; rotating into a cleaner dividend-growth story.
Industrial gases leader with pricing power, recurring on-site contracts, and 30+ years of dividend growth — durable defensive-industrial cash flow.
Dividend aristocrat with globally diversified, franchise-royalty cash flows that hold up across cycles — quality income compounder.
Utility with above-peer dividend growth (~10%/yr target) and renewables/grid capex tailwind from AI-driven power demand — adds defensive ballast.

outlook: Expect H2 to favor quality compounders with pricing power as rate-cut expectations and AI-driven power/industrial capex broaden leadership beyond H1's narrow semis/optics rally; this basket trims stretched/impaired names for steadier dividend growers in industrials, staples, and utilities.
